summary: Own the core product end to end: React, Next.js and TypeScript on the frontend, wired into Spring Boot and Node.js services backed by PostgreSQL and Redis, used by 25,000+ people across desktop, tablet and mobile.
highlights: Proposed and led the move to micro-frontends with Webpack Module Federation so teams deploy independently, cutting release cycles from 2 weeks to 2 days and the main bundle by 36%.
Built a reusable component library (tables, forms, modals, filters, notifications) before duplicate implementations piled up, cutting new-screen build time by 40% across 12+ modules.

Diagnosed slow, unindexed data-table interactions on high-traffic screens and rebuilt them with server-side search, filtering, sorting and pagination; paired with SSR/SSG to lift the Lighthouse/SEO score from 62 to 98.
Replaced spreadsheet-based candidate onboarding, which cost operations 8 hours a week, with an internal ATS dashboard in React and Node.js, cutting onboarding turnaround by 55%.
Closed an access-control gap with JWT auth and role-based access control across Spring Boot REST APIs, PostgreSQL and Redis, so each role sees only the data it's allowed to.
Raised test coverage to 80% with Jest and React Testing Library, and brought AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) into the team's daily workflow.
